tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Use this when the user wants detailed metrics for a specific card: PSA 10 reference price, population, market cap, price changes, daily history, and canonical URL. Requires an exact card ID from search_cards. Prices are daily published observations in USD, not live or executable quotes. Null values
